description: Second-agent benchmark tasks — MODEL-DEPENDENT tier only (scripts/agent-eval.mjs --with-llm --scenario second-agent). Each task is handed to a FRESH model whose only brand knowledge is the real brand_context output for its task_type, served from a temp copy of test/fixtures/brand-complete that the harness brand_compiles first. The reply is scored deterministically with the real brand_check and brand_check_compliance tools. check_inputs lists which brand_check inputs apply: 'text' always; 'css' only for markup tasks (extracted from a fenced code block — no fence means the reply is scored text-only and that is recorded); 'color' means the first hex in the reply is checked against the governed palette (no hex means the color check is skipped and recorded). budget records which brand_context budget serves the task (exactly one task uses compact). Schema is enforced by validateSecondAgentTasks in scripts/agent-eval.mjs via test/eval-harness.test.ts.

tasks.instruction: Write a 2-sentence launch post for a new analytics feature.
tasks.notes: Pure text task on the compact context budget — measures whether the tightest governed context still transfers the brand.

tasks.instruction: Write a 3-sentence introduction for a blog article about keeping every brand surface consistent.
tasks.notes: Copy task; the standard budget serves voice + strategy sections.

tasks.instruction: Write an email inviting a customer to renew their annual plan. Format: one line starting with 'Subject: ', then a blank line, then a body of at most 3 sentences.
tasks.notes: Subject + body structure; scored as text.

tasks.instruction: Write a CSS style block for a landing-page hero section (background, heading, and a call-to-action button) using the brand's colors and font. Return only the CSS inside one fenced code block.
tasks.notes: Markup task: css is extracted from the fenced block; color checks the first hex in the reply against the governed palette (#2a4494 / #e8523f / #f5a623).

tasks.instruction: Write a small HTML snippet with an inline <style> block for a call-to-action card (headline, one supporting sentence, button) using the brand's colors and typography. Return only the snippet inside one fenced code block.
tasks.notes: HTML+CSS task; the fenced snippet is passed to brand_check as css and the whole reply to brand_check_compliance.
